text: Support errors (P+N, 3 seeds, walk test): airborne<->full confusions are 0.61 % of non-partial windows; 75 % of them are at a GT label transition (touchdown / lift-off frame: the frame-mean true Fz crosses the 2 N contact threshold within the 20 ms frame; sensor total Fz there, median 3.8 N). The 'full' F1 is lowered mainly by full->partial predictions (3.2 % of full windows, 10 % at transitions), consistent with the a-priori partial class weight (x3). No label or code bug found; labels and weights unchanged.
